ambiguities: injuries_2025.parquet and injuries_2026.parquet have no date_modified column; treated as 'no parseable date_modified' so those rows are never used. Every 2025/2026 team-game therefore has no usable row and all five columns are missing.

Injury rows are joined to team-games on the literal numeric (season, week, team), with team codes replaced. Postseason week numbers are used as-is, with no remapping between injury-report and schedule week numbering. Rows with a missing season or week are dropped.
Code replacement is applied only to team columns (home_team, away_team, posteam, injury team). game_id strings keep their original codes, e.g. 2013_01_ARI_STL with team LA.
Output rows are team-games of kept games (season >= 2013 with home_score present). Unplayed or scheduled games without a score are excluded.

A player's history spans all teams he played for: his rows are every (game, T) with a target or carry, keyed by receiver/rusher player id. A listed injured player's share value comes from this history whatever team generated it, matched by injury gsis_id = pbp player id.
'Strictly before d' compares calendar dates (gameday), so another game on the same date is excluded.
Targets/carries need play_type exactly 'pass'/'run', so 'no_play' and other play types are excluded. Red-zone target: yardline_100 <= 20; a missing yardline_100 counts as not red zone.
Player-level sums include rows where the player had only carries (tgt = rzt = air = 0), so his target/air/rz shares are 0 when the denominator is > 0, not undefined.

EWM weights follow pandas halflife=4, adjust=True, ignore_na=False, min_periods=0. If a player's games so far have only undefined values for a share, the value is undefined, which counts as 0 in the sums.
Usable rows: date_modified (UTC) <= kickoff (UTC), inclusive. Kickoff localizes gameday + gametime[:5] (missing -> 09:00) to America/New_York, with no ambiguous or nonexistent DST times encountered.
Listed players are distinct gsis_id per team-game among usable rows, even if the player appears on several reports with Out/Doubtful status.
